title: MerchantAvailabilityDto
description: MerchantAvailabilityDto schema from Quandoo Public Partner API

dateTime.description: The date the review created on. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

occupancy.description: The occupancy of this availability option across the restaurant. This is an integer number between 0 and 100.

areaIds.description: The ids of the areas this availability option can be reserved for.

vaultSettingsId.description: The id of the Vault Settings applicable on this availability option.
